groundCutout.basis: Only the bridge and immediate straight approach ribbons reconstruct a bounded rendered bank. This prevents coarse high banks from covering the bridge or leaving sky holes underneath. The rendered cap is approximate, not surveyed riverbed. The inset bridge interior also caps intersecting native river-walk paving at the same bank level, preserving its original route; approach joins outsideX±36.6m retain their authored deck elevations.
